Legal Name: Synchrony Financial (holding company) / Synchrony Bank (FSB subsidiary)

Ownership: Public (NYSE: SYF). No controlling shareholder.

Headquarters: 777 Long Ridge Road, Stamford, CT 06902

Evidence: E-001, E-002, E-003
